purpose: Approved evidence source taxonomy for parameter profiles when real calibration data are unavailable.

demo_default.description: Code/default demonstration value; no engineering claim.

synthetic_only.description: Generated data used for CI or examples; cannot support engineering claims.

bounded_assumption.description: Reviewed bounded engineering assumption with explicit uncertainty range.

engineering_assumption.description: Reviewed engineering assumption with explicit owner and validity limits.

public_literature.description: Public literature or standard model used as prior, not project calibration.

vendor_datasheet.description: Vendor data sheet or family-level specification, not serial-number calibration.

design_derived.description: CAD, mission design, geometry or configuration-derived value.

low_cost_bench.description: Local bench measurement; may support ground_calibrated for measured parameter only if dataset is registered.

formal_ground_test.description: Formal test or calibration report with dataset manifest.

flight_telemetry.description: In-flight telemetry correlation with dataset manifest.

ground_test.description: Backward-compatible formal ground-test source type used by V16 synthetic gate tests; requires dataset_id for real claims.

rules: synthetic_only and demo_default cannot support engineering_estimate or higher
engineering_estimate requires explicit uncertainty and reviewed/approved status
ground_calibrated and flight_correlated require calibration.dataset_id in registered manifest
surrogate engineering_estimate profiles must keep not_ground_calibrated status
